title: First Breath
description: A plain, glucose- and oxygen-rich environment. Build a cell that can actually stay alive in it.

narrative.intro: You are given a bare cytoplasm and a generous environment: plenty of glucose, plenty of oxygen. Nothing here is trying to kill you. The only question is whether you can wire up a cell that keeps its ATP above zero and actually builds biomass, rather than just sitting there.
narrative.outro: The cell holds a stable ATP surplus and is laying down biomass. It isn't evolving or adapting — you built a system that happens to balance, and it survives because the numbers balance, not because it 'wanted' to.

goals.description: Keep cytoplasmic ATP at or above 3 for 10 straight ticks.
Accumulate at least 2 units of biomass.

failConditions.description: ATP flatlined at zero for 15 ticks — the cell is dead.
